gold_sql: SELECT b.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases b JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE b.base_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/base.py::BaseAgent' AND NOT f.is_test AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.calls c JOIN code.symbols cs ON cs.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = cs.file_id WHERE c.callee_symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id AND c.call_kind = 'direct' AND NOT cf.is_test) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.calls c JOIN code.symbols cs ON cs.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = cs.file_id WHERE c.callee_symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id AND c.call_kind = 'direct' AND cf.is_test) ORDER BY 1
